setup: Hands on the floor, a bit wider than shoulders
Feet up on a bench or box behind you
Brace so your body is one straight line
execution: Lower your chest toward the floor
Push the floor away to straight arms
Keep your hips in line all the way
faults: Don't let your hips sag toward the floor
Don't pike your hips up high

notes: Start with a low step and raise the feet over time; the higher the feet, the more load on the shoulders.
Make sure the bench or box can't slide back.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
